FX-PEMIT-001.says: The settings as added, at frames 0, 6 and 12: nothing at frame 0, then 100 white soft dots a second thrown every way at about 100 pixels a second, so fast most are out of the 16 by 10 layer within frames; the layer's own picture is gone.

FX-PEMIT-002.says: One particle, still, in the middle: a white Sphere 8 pixels across, feathered by half its radius.

FX-PEMIT-004.says: Sphere Feather 100: soft from the middle out.

FX-PEMIT-005.says: A Glow Sphere: a solid core half as wide and a faint glow round it.

FX-PEMIT-007.says: A Cloudlet: soft all the way to its edge.

FX-PEMIT-008.says: A still Streak: no movement, so a round dot as wide as the size.

FX-PEMIT-009.says: A tiny sphere, size 1: drawn 1.4 pixels across and fainter by its true size.

FX-PEMIT-010.says: Size Over Life 100, 30, 100, 100, 100: at a fifth of its life it is shrinking towards the second level, about 37 per cent of its size.

FX-PEMIT-011.says: Opacity Over Life 0, 100, 100, 100, 100: fading in, about 90 per cent at a fifth of its life.

FX-PEMIT-013.says: Opacity Over Life keyed: the second level from 100 at frame 0 to 10 at frame 20, read at the frame drawn.

FX-PEMIT-014.says: Opacity Random 80 on a spread of still dots: each its own opacity.

FX-PEMIT-015.says: Size Random 80 on the spread: each its own size.

FX-PEMIT-016.says: Life Random 90 on the spread: some gone early, at frames 20 and 40.

FX-PEMIT-018.says: Over Life: at a fifth of its life, between white and yellow on the gradient.

FX-PEMIT-019.says: Random From Gradient on the spread: each dot a colour from white to dark red.

FX-PEMIT-020.says: Color Random 70 on the spread: each dot its own brightness.

FX-PEMIT-021.says: A Sphere emitter 14 wide, 8 high and 30 deep: still dots in a ball, the far ones smaller and nearer the middle.

FX-PEMIT-022.says: A Grid emitter 4 by 2 over 12 by 6 pixels: a dot a frame, filling the grid point by point in rows.

FX-PEMIT-023.says: The grid turned 30 degrees about Z.

FX-PEMIT-024.says: The particle 11 pixels farther away and up the left: smaller, drawn nearer the middle.

FX-PEMIT-025.says: Two overlapping blue dots, Normal: the newer over the older.

FX-PEMIT-026.says: The two, Add: brighter where they overlap.

FX-PEMIT-028.says: A burst every way, at frames 6, 12, 24 and 40. Frame 40 drawn alone is the same as after frames 0 to 39.

FX-PEMIT-029.says: Directional, spread 10: a jet upwards within 18 degrees.

FX-PEMIT-030.says: The jet turned 90 degrees about Z: to the right.

FX-PEMIT-031.says: Bi-Directional, spread 10: up and down at once.

FX-PEMIT-032.says: Disc, the emitter turned 90 degrees about X so the axis faces us: a ring spreading out on the screen.

FX-PEMIT-033.says: Outwards from a Sphere emitter 6 across: away from its middle.

FX-PEMIT-034.says: Inwards into a Sphere emitter 14 across, slowly: towards its middle.

FX-PEMIT-035.says: Gravity 60 on the jet: it arcs back down.

FX-PEMIT-036.says: Air Resistance 3: the burst slows and stays tight.

FX-PEMIT-037.says: Wind X 40 on the jet: it bends to the right.

FX-PEMIT-038.says: Turbulence 400 at scale 4 on the jet: it wanders.

FX-PEMIT-039.says: Bounce on a floor at 80 per cent: a fountain from the top falls and bounces.

FX-PEMIT-040.says: Slide: they land and slide along the floor.

FX-PEMIT-042.says: Velocity From Motion 100 with the emitter keyed across: the particles carry its motion.

FX-PEMIT-043.says: Particles Per Second keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 110 at frame 20: births start slowly and quicken.

FX-PEMIT-044.says: The ball of FX-PEMIT-021 through a composition camera 12 pixels in front: the far dots much smaller, the near ones larger.

FX-PEMIT-045.says: FX-PEMIT-028 with the layer starting at frame 10: nothing before, frame 22 the same as FX-PEMIT-028's frame 12.

FX-PEMIT-046.says: FX-PEMIT-028 with the layer moved 3 pixels right.

FX-PEMIT-050.says: Streaks on the burst: each a short line back along its last frame.

FX-PEMIT-051.says: A burst of glowing sparks: Over Life colours, shrinking and fading, added.

FX-PEMIT-052.says: Particles Per Second -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
